newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura regains lead in May commission fees--paper.
newsitem.headline: Nomura regains lead in May commission fees--paper.

text.p: Nomura Securities Co Ltd earned the largest commission revenues among brokerages operating in Japan in May for the first time in three months, a business daily reported on Thursday.

Although the company's share of stock trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in May lagged those of Daiwa Securities Co Ltd and Nikko Securities Co Ltd, Nomura was strong in small-lot deals, which carry proportionately higher commissions than larger transactions, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
Nomura earned commission revenues of about 8.3 billion yen in May, compared with a little over 8.0 billion yen for Daiwa.

But Nomura saw its total commission fees in April and May decline by more than 40 percent from the same period a year ago, while those of Daiwa fell by 20 percent and Nikko's by a little over 30 percent, the paper said.
A Nomura spokeswoman declined to comment on the report.
